decisionsTitle: «Ghid de mărimi»: the supplier's size-chart picture, opened from beside the size select
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-11, ordering a shirt in the members' zone:** «vreau să pun un tooltip cu o poză pentru ghid mărimi». The supplier's sheet is a drawing — chest width, length, per size — and §700's numbers-per-size table does not replace it.

**Decision.** A product carries one optional picture, its «Ghid de mărimi»: `shop_products.size_guide_media_asset_id` (a stored picture of the gallery, `ON DELETE SET NULL`) and `size_guide_crop` (the four fractions of §541, null for the whole picture), migration `0140`, expand only. In the editor it is a field under «Mărimile» (`ProductSizesCard`): the picture field of «Echipa» and the pictures card (`TeamPhotoField`, given its own field stem `sizeGuide` so a second picture field can share the product's form, and told to start the picture whole — a drawing must not lose its edges to the person photo's default square), posted as `sizeGuideAssetId` and `sizeGuideCrop`, saved with the product under its version and audit row (`sizeGuide: true|false`, never a title). `fields.ts` accepts a UUID or empty; a bad id or crop is refused naming the picture's box; the service refuses an id that is no stored picture. An empty field clears both columns.

In the members' zone, when a guide is set and the product has a size select, a «Ghid de mărimi» button, which also shows the picture on hover, stands beside the select on a laptop and under it on a phone (44 px, the ruler glyph). Pressing it opens the picture large through the house's picture lightbox of §601 — the ladder `srcset`, pinch-zoom, Back and Escape close — with alt «Ghid de mărimi — <product title>». The lightbox gained an optional `crop` and the picture's size, so a cropped guide opens as the club cropped it. The picture is counted by `media/references.ts` (the sweep, the delete guard and «used by» on the pictures page, as the members' page, like the strip's).

**Both a hover and a press.** The owner asked for a tooltip; members order from phones, where a hover does not exist, so the picture is reached two ways. On a pointer device, resting on the button (or focusing it) shows the picture small above it, the way the calendar's tooltip does (§261): `SizeGuideHover`, a shop-only client island that owns MUI's `Tooltip` around the button the page renders on the server (which arrives as `children`), and takes only strings and numbers — the thumbnail's address, the picture's size, the crop — so no element crosses the boundary as a prop (§370). It never opens on touch (`disableTouchListener`) and draws no picture until a pointer rests on it, so a page of products pays nothing. Everyone, touch included, can press the button to open the picture large.

**The help says what is true of the field.** The guide field has its own captions («Se păstrează când salvezi produsul»; «Pornește întreagă… Decupează doar dacă desenul are margini»), not the strip's, whose help promises a picture added on the spot and a square start; the explanation lives in the field's own help, after its legend, not in a paragraph above it. A refused guide or crop is named «Ghidul de mărimi (o poză)» in the summary (`productRefusalMessages`). In the editor a guide with no crop is drawn whole (96 px, its own ratio), as the zone and the lightbox draw it. The lightbox asks the ladder for the cropped window's width: `min(100vw, 100vh × the window's ratio) / w`.

**Refused.** A tooltip-only picture (no touch). A picture per size (one drawing covers them all; the per-size numbers stay in the chart). Replacing the numeric chart (the chart stays for suppliers who give numbers). Amends §700.
changelogLine: - **«Ghid de mărimi» on a product** — the supplier's size-chart picture, chosen per product under «Mărimile»: it shows small on hover over a button beside the size select in the members' shop, and opens large on a press, with pinch-zoom. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: A product's save, by a role that may manage the shop, keeps one optional «Ghid de mărimi» picture with its crop in `shop_products.size_guide_media_asset_id` / `size_guide_crop` — an id that is no UUID or no stored picture, or a crop that is no box, is refused naming the picture's box, an empty field clears both, and the pictures page counts the picture as the shop's and refuses to delete it (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The members' zone draws the «Ghid de mărimi» button beside a product's size select, opening the picture in the picture lightbox with the ladder `srcset` and the crop, and showing it small as a tooltip on a pointer's hover or focus (never on touch), only while the product has a guide picture and a size select (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
